label: Whatever is CONTAINED_IN_1 a bearer without being a real constituent of it is apprehended by it
paraphrase: OPEN conceptualist premise about non-real being, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (the classical thesis that beings of reason have being only in the intellect, generalized; Augustine, Leibniz and Plantinga are navigation only): for every bearer b and item e, if e is contained in b (CONTAINED_IN_1) and is not a real constituent of b, then b itself apprehends e. It is general: it mentions no favouring, value or root. It entails that a bearer that apprehends nothing contains no non-real item. Its denial is the claim that some bearer contains a non-real item mind-independently: on the noncognitive imitability-exemplar rival (A4) the modes of imitability of a simple nature; on a Scotist reading, formalities distinguished a parte rei but not really. It is strictly stronger than the root cognition criterion given the other premises of its derivation (Comparator companion rootCriterionWithoutConceptualism); restricted to the root route it would be equivalent to that criterion.
